reviews.title: Denied boarding involuntarily on irrelevant reasons
reviews.text: I have a complaint against FlyArystan on denying us boarding involuntarily on irrelevant grounds. We are family of four (including 2 small children), Indian nationals and we are residing in United Arab Emirates (UAE). According to law, it is visa free for UAE residents to enter Uzbekistan. Despite submitting all the required documents at the check in, FlyArystan denied us boarding. He told us that we could only enter to Uzbekistan if we have Uzbekistan e-visa. This was straight up false as the rule states UAE residency visa holders with a validity of 90 days can travel visa free of charge as per Uzbekistan. We took a leap of faith and rebooked with Uzbekistan Airlines. The fact that we boarded on the same day from same airport to Uzbekistan is the main proof that your airlines denied our boarding on irrelevant reasons. We wrote to FlyArystan customer service for compensation and they are denying their mistake by giving irrelevant reasons that keeps on changing.
reviews.author: Sulthana Rafeek

reviews.title: Dont fly with flyarystan
reviews.text: Have a nice day. I flew with this airline a few times. Even though I had a ticket in my hand, it was said, "We have run out of space on the plane." another time I have hand luggage 5 kg. I had my notebook with me. 7000tenge extra baggage allowance was taken by adding the notebook key to the hand luggage. A non-human company where employees follow brutal directives from bosses.
reviews.author: Murat C

reviews.title: Overpriced!!! And bad customer service!
reviews.text: I took this airline when I flew in from LA to visit my grandma in the north Kazakhstan, I usually fly with Air Astana when I come visit. This was my first time flying with FlyArystan and I ended up paying double the ticket at the gate because of some baggage weight (and I already paid for it when I booked the flight) so so unprofessional!!! And very bad NON EXISTENT customer service! It is aweful! You literally have to figure everything out somehow yourself electronically so what is even the point to have people working at the desk? So confusing and just flat out bad! Very bad airline, shady and you don’t know what to expect until you get there: they don’t value their customers for sure so if you can fly with ANY other airline please do. Safe yourself from bad customer service, uncomfortable seats and VERY overpriced hidden strange fees. Such a rip off. Do not fly with them.
reviews.author: Nadia P

reviews.title: A terrible airline to be chosen only in the absense of other options
reviews.text: I fly with this airline because my parents live in a remote area - Kostanay, where no other airline can reach. This airline is an extreme example of the worst possible service you could get. The policies are inflexible, I have lost my money on their voucher program since they open flight bookings only for the 4 upcoming months and my voucher expiration date was before the date I need to fly. On the flight, it was very poor service. Would never recommend anyone to deal with them.
reviews.author: Larissa S

reviews.title: Avoid that airline. Избегайте эти авиалинии
reviews.text: Never use the airline. Its common practice for the to postpond the flight, for every hour. It can be up to 1 day delay with each hour announcement.
reviews.author: Mira

reviews.title: Poor mobile app functionality, poor service support
reviews.text: App is limited infunctionality, also have some bugs and i was not able to finalize my check-in and ofload boarding pass, not information on why it was happening. The online support is total fiasco, at some point the chat bot simply stops answering and you are not even able to connect to operator. Extremely inconvenient service. My points are 2 out of five not 1, since FA have more or less good planes and flight crew trying. The only reason i chose FY there were no other options.
reviews.author: Zamanbek M

reviews.title: The best price for flight from Almaty
reviews.text: I had a flight from Almaty to Yerevan on 27 of June. This was a new direction for Fly Arystan and I was happy cause all other options to come to Armenia were more expensive. My flight cost only 80$ + 25$ for a baggage. I know this airlines as a good one cause I had many trips before around Kazakhstan and once to Dubai. The planes are clean, comfortable. Stuff is nice and polite. The only one bad thing happened, my flight was delayed from 11 am to 7 pm, they send me sms about it. I had only 3 days in Armenia so I was sad that the first day I needed to stay in Kazakhstan. But now I find out that they cancelled the flight to Yerevan from Almaty, and there is only flight from Aktau. It’s a pity! It was so convenient flight, could you consider the possibility of departure from Almaty again?
reviews.author: Malika B

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: Planned travel to Baku from Atyrau and onwards.from Aktau cancelled same day of travel. No reason given. And had to reschedule on very expensive flights via a lengthy route via Istanbul. Not only was it a very long expensive journey, but I had to reschedule meetings in Baku, and as as I was meeting someone traveling from Aberdeen in UK, he had to reschedule also. Now today using the return portion, we get notice that one of the return flights had been cancelled due to operational reasons. Completely unreliable and will never use them again.
reviews.author: RDWH

reviews.title: A convenient flight from Almaty to Yerevan
reviews.text: There is only one flight available from Almaty to Yerevan by FlyArystan airline. This is the only true lowcost airline in the country. We got fairly enough inexpensive tickets to get to the dream place - Yerevan. The board is a new AirBus with convenient seats. It wasn’t full, so I had the three row seats to myself and even was able to sleep. I pre-ordered the hot plov and they served it with 30 minutes after the take off. The overall experience was quite excellent! It was my third fly with FlyArystan and I will definitely continue flying with them
reviews.author: Danat A

reviews.title: It's cheap for a reason
reviews.text: I'm at the airport in Turkestan waiting for someone to come and tell me I can go through customs because their system says I need a visa for Turkey...I don't! I've been waiting over an hour...
reviews.author: Bernard M

reviews.title: Professional employee Muldarisova Moldr
reviews.text: I am Adiguzel Erkan came from Turkey to Kazakhstan on a business trip to the city of Nursultan, flew from Nursultan to Almaty with the airline сompany Fly Arystan. I was very impressed with the work of the employee who worked at the check-in Muldarisova Moldr. I was so pleased that such a young beautiful,polite girl perfectly,fluently spoke in my language.She spoke Turkish so professionally and I was very pleased to hear my native language from a foreigner. Actually I had a problem with my luggage and Moldr has explained to me very clearly,professionally. Then I watched her work with other passengers for a long time and there were aggressive local passengers and Moldir was able to solve their problems and they were satisfied as I was. I am sure that Fly Arystan airline company will have a good future with such an employee. I just want to appreciate her for help me and wish her further only success.
reviews.author: Erkan Adiguzel

reviews.title: Among the best customer service I've ever encountered
reviews.text: I was travelling from Kyzylorda to Nur-Sultan, supervisor Akniyet was really nice and helpfull. Before the flight I had some major issues with my luggage. Supervisor Akniyet makes attempt to help me at all in that tough situation. Actually the plane was very clean, thanks for all members of FlyArystan. Thanks for best service! With best wishes Nurila
reviews.author: Nurila Omirzak

reviews.title: Obtaining a refund. Customer relations absolutely useless! Still waiting after 8 weeks.
reviews.text: I purchased a ticket and paid online for extra baggage. Then at check-in the extra baggage was not reflected on my ticket so I was charged double again. I was told to request a refund. customer relations totally useless, after eight weeks and many many calls and emails, no refund. This was certainly one of the most expensive flights I have ever taken.
reviews.author: Caroline C

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY FLYARYSTAN AS A FOREIGNER
reviews.text: Flyarystan is a budget airline based in Kazakhstan. A new route recently opened up from Istanbul, Turkey to Turkistan, Kazakhstan. Despite having a valid visa to Kazakhstan (B10 private visa) from the embassy in Ankara, FlyArystan denied us boarding (after already letting us through baggage check and us going through passport control into the international zone). We even got a representative from the embassy of Kazakhstan in Ankara to tell the airline supervisor, Nugrisa Zhakupov to let us through to Kazakhstan but he would not budge. He told us that only Americans with a diplomatic passport could enter Kazakhstan. This was straight up false as even with the COVID-19 situation direct family members are allowed to enter Kazakhstan (in our case, marriage). Despite us knowing it was false we still had to stress out for days and reenter Turkey (claiming our baggage) and waisting money on accommodation that we can barely afford as we are on a budget. We took a leap of faith and rebooked with Turkish Airlines instead as the embassy official said to take this airline or AirAstana. I now write from Kazakhstan as we successfully made it. FlyArystan still has not given us a refund and the embassy of Kazakhstan in Ankara told us to sue. Flying to is listed as Almaty only because Turkistan is unavailable.
reviews.author: Isaac Sechslingloff

reviews.title: Terrible service of call center
reviews.text: Terrible service indeed. I was trying to book the tix to fly from Pavlodar to almaty . My cat got sick and he needs the urgent transportation to almaty to the clinic. I asked to book the tickets for the next day(29 hours before the flight) , and they could not help me, only answering we understand and that’s it. i asked for exception as the days are counting it’s an emergency case( his leg became paralyzed, he lost the second one bc of cancer). They only were replying we understand but we can’t attach this service to reservation,the system is not allowing us.you need to book it in advance. The only reason was in the system but you have IT guys. The seats are assigned in the airport I was flying before with the cat, no need to say there are special seats assigned, random seats, exactly random!!! I didn’t ask for anything special, I don’t know if these 3 days of waiting can cost the life of my pet, but you could make an exception.
reviews.author: ksenia

reviews.title: They never help you
reviews.text: I called to call center 1000 times and wrote email to rebook my ticket to another day. But they have never replied to help me, they are not Responsible
reviews.author: Laz U

reviews.title: No more emergency rows for me!
reviews.text: The first lowcoster of Kazakhstan, as I was told FlyArystan is associated with Air Astana which assures people in the safety of the planes. My return flight in general was ok. so usually check in myself online and this time was not an exception. But this time I didn’t realize that I chose seats next to emergency exits. Never again! FlyArystan flight attendants bugged me during the take off and landing as you’re not allowed to have any bags or clothes near you during all the flight as your hands should be free in case of the evacuation.
reviews.author: Kym

reviews.title: Bad service prices went up
reviews.text: We were treated rudely at check in. Prices a month before we’re less than half of what we paid this time, so their prices are nearly the same as air Astana now
reviews.author: Edlin

reviews.title: Unreasonable high price, unfriendly service
reviews.text: Date: June 7, 2019 Route: TSE - ALA Flight number: KC7054 Check in in TSE was smooth and friendly. Passenger Service Agent was very polite, professional, she asked all required security questions, printed boarding pass and wished a pleasant flight. Boarding also went very smoothly. However, cabin crew were not as much friendly and polite as was advertised. They were very much arrogant and unfriendly, especially in the way they treated passengers during service. The feeling was like you are flying on such a worst airline ever in terms of treatment, cold voice tone of cabin crew members and their complete indifference. My advice is that cabin crew should be a bit more friendly and professional, their rude behavior leads to a low quality of service and bad image of the entire airline. The cost of ticket was more that KZT 20K, and I expected a bit more friendly and polite behavior. Will I recommend Fly Arystan? Most likely - no. Just because of cabin service. I am giving 2 out 5 just for good passenger handling in TSE airport. In all other aspects this airline does not worth to be chosen. Unless the price is 7K. Thank you.
reviews.author: AgentCoordinator
